home_sections.testimonials_title: Sweet Moments Loved by Every Guest
home_sections.testimonials_desc: Genuine thoughts from artisanal sourdough and French pastry lovers in Saigon.
home_sections.review1_comment: The croissants at Windie Cake are authentically French—intense AOP butter fragrance and stunning flaky lamination. My morning coffee's best companion!
home_sections.review2_comment: The natural sourdough boasts an open, chewy crumb and a crackling crust with subtle tanginess. Packed with supreme care and always delivered warm.
home_sections.review3_comment: The fresh strawberry Mascarpone chiffon cake was lightly sweet, airy, and refreshing without heaviness. My entire family loved every bite!
home_sections.craft_desc: At Windie Cake, we believe a truly memorable loaf is born when artisans pour their hearts into every minute detail—from heirloom flour selection to the exact timing of oven steam.
home_sections.craft_point1_desc: Slow resting cultivates deep complex flavors and an airy, digestible crumb structure.
home_sections.craft_point2_desc: Premium AOP cultured butter with 84% milk fat brings unmatched aroma and crisp lamination.
home_sections.craft_point3_desc: Our deck ovens fire up at 4 AM so you are greeted with the warmth of freshly baked creations.
